author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Market stall mirrored about x=24: trapezoid awning with two stripe dividers and three scallops, posts from the awning corners to the ground, a counter shelf with a pile of three round fruits. Lucide store/awning construction (flared awning with scallops over posts).
omissions: The three separate apples with stems become one pile of three round bumps; separate fruits cannot keep 8 apart from each other and from the posts inside 36 units. The fourth awning stripe is dropped (panels would be 7 apart).
